description: Source code for embedded resource forks accessor functions in the FreeType project, including functions for reading resource fork headers, data offsets, and guessing resource fork types on various systems.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_HeaderInfo
methods.description: Reads the header information of a resource fork at a given offset, returning data position and map offset.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_DataOffsets
methods.description: Retrieves data offsets for resources of a specific type within a resource fork, with optional sorting by resource ID.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Guess
methods.description: Guesses resource fork types and locations based on system-specific heuristics and file naming conventions.

methods.name: ft_raccess_rule_by_darwin_vfs
methods.description: Determines if a given rule index corresponds to a Darwin VFS resource fork type.
